changelog: Rebuilt 0-0-2 as a pure landscape 2D side-view pickleball game.
Left thumb now controls Back and Forward movement with no auto-footwork.
Right thumb has Dink, Lob, Drive and Flick shot buttons.
Added side-view ball physics, net collision, bounce handling, timing range and CPU positioning.
Preserves the v1.5.6 navigation and booking fixes.
